entries.title: Numbers 18:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah said to Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

entries.title: Numbers 18:2
segments: And thy brethren also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring near with thee, that they may unite with thee, and minister unto thee; but thou and thy sons with thee [shall serve] before the tent of the testimony.

entries.title: Numbers 18:3
segments: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of the whole tent: only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they may not die, and you as well as they.

entries.title: Numbers 18:4
segments: And they shall unite with thee, and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; and no stranger shall come near to you.

entries.title: Numbers 18:5
segments: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar; that there come no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 18:6
segments: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren, the Levites, from among the children of Israel; to you are they given as a gift for Jehovah to perform the service of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Numbers 18:7
segments: But thou and thy sons with thee shall attend to your priesthood for all that concerneth the altar, and for that which is inside the veil; and ye shall perform the service: I give you your priesthood as a service of gift, and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

entries.title: Numbers 18:8
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Aaron, And I, behold, I have given thee the charge of my heave-offerings, of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; to thee have I given them, because of the anointing, and to thy sons by an everlasting statute.

entries.title: Numbers 18:9
segments: This shall be thine of the most holy things, [reserved] from the fire: every offering of theirs, of all their oblations, and of all their sin-offerings, and of all their trespass-offerings, which they render unto me, it is most holy for thee and for thy sons.

entries.title: Numbers 18:10
segments: As most holy shalt thou eat it: every male shall eat it; it shall be holy unto thee.

entries.title: Numbers 18:11
segments: And this shall be thine: the heave-offering of their gift, with all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by an everlasting statute; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

entries.title: Numbers 18:12
segments: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they give to Jehovah, have I given thee.

entries.title: Numbers 18:13
segments: The first ripe of everything that is in their land, which they shall bring to Jehovah, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

entries.title: Numbers 18:14
segments: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be thine.

entries.title: Numbers 18:15
segments: Everything that breaketh open the womb of all flesh, which they present to Jehovah, of men or of beasts, shall be thine; nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou in any case ransom, and the firstborn of unclean beasts shalt thou ransom.

entries.title: Numbers 18:16
segments: And those that are to be ransomed from a month old shalt thou ransom, according to thy valuation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

entries.title: Numbers 18:17
segments: But the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, thou shalt not ransom: they are holy. Thou shalt sprinkle their blood on the altar, and their fat shalt thou burn as an offering by fire for a sweet odour to Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 18:18
segments: And their flesh shall be thine; as the wave-breast and as the right shoulder shall it be thine.

entries.title: Numbers 18:19
segments: All the heave-offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Jehovah, have I given thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by an everlasting statute: it shall be an everlasting covenant of salt before Jehovah unto thee and thy seed with thee.

entries.title: Numbers 18:20
segments: ¶And Jehovah said to Aaron, In their land thou shalt have no inheritance, neither shalt thou have any portion among them: I am thy portion and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 18:21
segments: And to the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithes in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they perform, the service of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Numbers 18:22
segments: Neither shall the children of Israel henceforth come near the tent of meeting, to bear sin and die.

entries.title: Numbers 18:23
segments: But the Levite, he shall perform the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it is an everlasting statute throughout your generations. And among the children of Israel shall they possess no inheritance;

entries.title: Numbers 18:24
segments: for I have given for an inheritance to the Levites the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as a heave-offering to Jehovah; therefore I have said of them, They shall possess no inheritance among the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 18:25
segments: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 18:26
segments: And to the Levites shalt thou speak, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer a heave-offering from it for Jehovah, the tenth of the tithe.

entries.title: Numbers 18:27
segments: And your heave-offering shall be reckoned unto you, as the corn from the threshing-floor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

entries.title: Numbers 18:28
segments: Thus ye also shall offer Jehovah's heave-offering of all your tithes, which ye take of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof Jehovah's heave-offering to Aaron the priest.

entries.title: Numbers 18:29
segments: Out of all that is given you ye shall offer the whole heave-offering of Jehovah, --of all the best thereof the hallowed part thereof.

entries.title: Numbers 18:30
segments: And thou shalt say unto them, When ye heave the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as produce of the threshing-floor, and as produce of the winepress.

entries.title: Numbers 18:31
segments: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households; for it is your reward for your service in the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Numbers 18:32
segments: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, if ye heave from it the best of it; and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
